parts.premise: The “10-Minute Rule” formulated by the National PTA and the National Education Association suggests that kids should be doing about 10 minutes of homework per night per grade level. This translates to 10 minutes of homework for first graders, going up to 120 minutes for twelfth graders. Do we  simply apply this number, or do we consider the quality of the homework done? It is in fact a lot more complicated…
parts.hypothesis: Guidelines recommend no homework for first grade students and 10 minutes for second grade.
